title: Ask about Bea's baptism register
subject: Baptism register enquiry, Brookfield, 1890

aim.why_now: The baptism entry can guide us to the right parish.

cost_note: Ask for a quote before ordering copies.
how: Email the archive; copy the subject and text below.
text:
Hello,

Do you hold the baptism register for the fictional village of Brookfield for 1890? I am researching my great-grandmother Bea. Please let me know the reference and how to request a copy.

Thank you,
Alex
